D: Thirty years after the Empire fell, a scavenger and a runaway stormtrooper get caught up in the hunt for Luke Skywalker.
P: Serve the snacks when Rey makes her instant bread on Jakku.
S: Quick soda bread with a deep cross on top, torn apart warm
Quick soda bread of flour, buttermilk and bicarb mixed and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until it rises, torn warm with butter and honey.
Medjool dates filled with goat cheese and walnut, with honey, apricots and figs
Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a walnut half, drizzled with honey, with dried apricots and figs.

Saffron risotto balls with a melting mozzarella centre, crumbed and fried deep orange, with a smoky paprika aioli for the white stripe. Soak a pinch of saffron in 750ml hot stock. Soften an onion in butter, add 250g arborio and stir in the stock a ladle at a time for 18 minutes. Stir in 40g parmesan and spread out to cool. Shape 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella. Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and smoked paprika to dip.
M: Garlic rosemary lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, flatbreads, garlic yogurt
Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and paprika, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled apart with flatbreads, yoghurt and roasted vegetables.
the frozen forest on Starkiller Base

Barramundi baked in paper parcels with lemon, dill, capers and butter, torn open at the table, with crushed potatoes and a sharp fennel slaw. Lay 4 barramundi fillets on squares of baking paper. Top each with lemon slices, dill, 1 tsp capers and 15g butter, season and fold into sealed parcels. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes, crush with olive oil and salt. Shave a fennel bulb thin and toss with lemon juice, olive oil and dill. Open the parcels at the table.
W: Light cream and lemonade scones served warm with strawberry jam
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and whipped cream.
K: Coffee with hot cocoa milk, brown sugar and cinnamon

Strong coffee stirred into cocoa and cinnamon steamed milk, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa, served in metal mugs. Brew 250ml very strong coffee or 4 espresso shots. Warm 700ml milk with 3 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon, whisking until frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four metal mugs and pour in the hot chocolate milk. Top with whipped cream from 150ml cream and dust with cocoa.

s.note: Quick soda bread with a deep cross on top, torn apart warm
s.how: Mix 450g flour, a teaspoon of bicarb soda and a teaspoon of salt. Stir in 400ml buttermilk to a soft dough. Shape into a round, cut a deep cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it rises and sounds hollow. Tear warm and serve with butter and honey.

s.note: Medjool dates filled with goat cheese and walnut, with honey, apricots and figs
s.how: Slit 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a little goat's cheese and press a walnut half on top. Drizzle with honey and arrange on a board with dried apricots and dried figs, like rations traded for a portion at the outpost.

m.note: Garlic rosemary lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, flatbreads, garlic yogurt
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with crushed garlic, rosemary, smoked paprika, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart easily. Serve on a big board with warm flatbreads, garlic yoghurt and a tray of roasted vegetables.

w.note: Light cream and lemonade scones served warm with strawberry jam
w.how: Mix 450g self-raising flour with 300ml cream and 300ml lemonade until just combined. Pat out on a floured bench, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220C for 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and whipped cream.

d.note: Coffee with hot cocoa milk, brown sugar and cinnamon
d.how: Brew 250ml very strong coffee or 4 espresso shots. Warm 700ml milk with 3 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon, whisking until frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four metal mugs and pour in the hot chocolate milk. Top with whipped cream from 150ml cream and dust with cocoa.
